sentences.text_target: Every reliable commuter knows that winter weather often ruins daily transportation.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɛvəri rɪˈlaɪəbl kəˈmjutər noʊz ðæt ˈwɪntər ˈwɛðər ˈɔfn ˈruz ˈdeɪli ˌtrænspərˈteɪʃn/
sentences.text_native: Tous les navetteurs réguliers savent que les conditions hivernales gâchent souvent les transports quotidiens.

sentences.text_target: Mark woke up early because he had an important meeting downtown.
sentences.phonetic: /mɑrk woʊk ʌp ˈɜrli bɪˈkəz hi hæd ən ɪmˈpɔrtnt ˈmitɪŋ ˈdaʊnˌtaʊn/
sentences.text_native: Mark s'est réveillé tôt parce qu'il avait une réunion importante au centre-ville.

sentences.text_target: After drinking his coffee, he grabbed his heavy suitcase from the closet.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈæftər ˈdrɪŋkɪŋ hɪz ˈkɑfi, hi græbd hɪz ˈhɛvi ˈsutˌkeɪs frəm ðə ˈklɑzɪt/
sentences.text_native: Après avoir bu son café, il a pris sa lourde valise dans le placard.

sentences.text_target: He left his apartment in a hurry to reach the central station on time.
sentences.phonetic: /hi lɛft hɪz əˈpɑrtmənt ɪn ə ˈhɜri tu riʧ ðə ˈsɛntrəl ˈsteɪʃn ɑn taɪm/
sentences.text_native: Il a quitté son appartement en hâte pour arriver à la gare centrale à l'heure.

sentences.text_target: When he arrived at the platform, a sudden cancellation appeared on the board.
sentences.phonetic: /wɛn hi əˈraɪvd æt ðə ˈplætfɔrm, ə ˈsʌdn ˌkænsəˈleɪʃn əˈpɪrd ɑn ðə bɔrd/
sentences.text_native: Quand il est arrivé sur le quai, une annulation soudaine est apparue sur le panneau.

sentences.text_target: A loudspeaker announcement explained that severe technical issues caused major delays.
sentences.phonetic: /ə ˈlaʊdˌspikər əˈnaʊnsmənt ɪkˈspleɪnd ðæt sɪˈvɪr ˈtɛknɪkl ˈɪʃuz kɑzd ˈmeɪʤər dɪˈleɪz/
sentences.text_native: Une annonce par haut-parleur a expliqué que de graves problèmes techniques causaient d'importants retards.

sentences.text_target: Many frustrated passengers gathered around the ticket counter to ask questions.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈmɛni ˈfrʌstreɪtɪd ˈpæsənʤərz ˈgæðərd əˈraʊnd ðə ˈtɪkɪt ˈkaʊntər tu æsk ˈkwɛstʃənz/
sentences.text_native: De nombreux passagers frustrés se sont rassemblés autour du guichet pour poser des questions.

sentences.text_target: Mark realized he needed to find an alternative route immediately.
sentences.phonetic: /mɑrk ˈriəˌlaɪzd hi ˈnidɪd tu faɪnd ən ɔlˈtɜrnətɪv rut ɪˈmidiətli/
sentences.text_native: Mark a réalisé qu'il devait trouver un itinéraire de rechange immédiatement.

sentences.text_target: He quickly checked his smartphone for available bus connections.
sentences.phonetic: /hi ˈkwɪkli ʧɛkt hɪz ˈsmɑrtˌfoʊn fɔr əˈveɪləbl bəs kəˈnɛkʃənz/
sentences.text_native: Il a rapidement vérifié sur son smartphone les correspondances de bus disponibles.

sentences.text_target: Fortunately, a long-distance coach was leaving from the nearby terminal in ten minutes.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈfɔrʧənətli, ə lɔŋ ˈdɪstəns koʊʧ wʌz ˈlivɪŋ frəm ðə ˈnɪrbaɪ ˈtɜrmɪnl ɪn tɛn ˈmɪnɪts/
sentences.text_native: Heureusement, un car longue distance partait de la gare routière voisine dans dix minutes.

sentences.text_target: He walked rapidly through the cold street, carrying his luggage with difficulty.
sentences.phonetic: /hi wɔkt ˈræpɪdli θru ðə koʊld strit, ˈkæriɪŋ hɪz ˈlʌgɪʤ wɪð ˈdɪfəkəlti/
sentences.text_native: Il a marché d'un pas vif dans la rue froide, portant ses bagages avec difficulté.

sentences.text_target: At the desk, he paid the fare and received a small paper receipt.
sentences.phonetic: /æt ðə dɛsk, hi peɪd ðə fɛr ənd rɪˈsivd ə smɔl ˈpeɪpər rɪˈsit/
sentences.text_native: Au guichet, il a payé le tarif et a reçu un petit reçu en papier.

sentences.text_target: The driver asked him to validate his ticket before stepping inside.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈdraɪvər æskt hɪm tu ˈvæləˌdeɪt hɪz ˈtɪkɪt bɪˈfɔr ˈstɛpɪŋ ɪnˈsaɪd/
sentences.text_native: Le chauffeur lui a demandé de valider son ticket avant de monter à bord.

sentences.text_target: The vehicle was completely overcrowded because so many people missed their trains.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈvihɪkl wʌz kəmˈplitli ˌoʊvərˈkraʊdɪd bɪˈkəz soʊ ˈmɛni ˈpipəl mɪst ðɛr treɪnz/
sentences.text_native: Le véhicule était complètement bondé parce que tant de gens avaient raté leurs trains.

sentences.text_target: Mark found a narrow space near the back door to stand safely.
sentences.phonetic: /mɑrk faʊnd ə ˈnæroʊ speɪs nɪr ðə bæk dɔr tu stænd ˈseɪfli/
sentences.text_native: Mark a trouvé un espace étroit près de la porte arrière pour se tenir debout en toute sécurité.

sentences.text_target: He placed his heavy bag carefully on the overhead luggage rack.
sentences.phonetic: /hi pleɪst hɪz ˈhɛvi bæg ˈkɛrfəli ɑn ði ˈoʊvərˌhɛd ˈlʌgɪʤ ræk/
sentences.text_native: Il a posé son sac lourd avec précaution sur le porte-bagages supérieur.

sentences.text_target: Heavy traffic slowed down their progress on the busy highway bridge.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈhɛvi ˈtræfɪk sloʊd daʊn ðɛr ˈprɑgrəs ɑn ðə ˈbɪzi ˈhaɪˌweɪ brɪʤ/
sentences.text_native: Une circulation dense a ralenti leur progression sur le pont autoroutier très fréquenté.

sentences.text_target: The friendly conductor apologized for the general travel disruption.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈfrɛndli kənˈdʌktər əˈpɑləˌʤaɪzd fɔr ðə ˈʤɛnərəl ˈtrævəl dɪsˈrʌpʃn/
sentences.text_native: Le sympathique contrôleur s'est excusé pour la perturbation générale du trafic.

sentences.text_target: Another passenger standing in the aisle offered to help him adjust his coat.
sentences.phonetic: /əˈnʌðər ˈpæsənʤər ˈstændɪŋ ɪn ðə aɪl ˈɔfərd tu hɛlp hɪm əˈʤʌst hɪz koʊt/
sentences.text_native: Un autre passager debout dans l'allée s'est proposé pour l'aider à ajuster son manteau.

sentences.text_target: They crossed the big river while raindrops fell heavily against the glass window.
sentences.phonetic: /ðeɪ krɑst ðə bɪg ˈrɪvər waɪl ˈreɪnˌdrɑps fɛl ˈhɛvɪli əˈgɛnst ðə glæs ˈwɪndoʊ/
sentences.text_native: Ils ont traversé le grand fleuve tandis que des gouttes de pluie frappaient lourdement contre la vitre.

sentences.text_target: Mark looked outside at the gray buildings passing by very slowly.
sentences.phonetic: /mɑrk lʊkt ˈaʊtˌsaɪd æt ðə greɪ ˈbɪldɪŋz ˈpæsɪŋ baɪ ˈvɛri ˈsloʊli/
sentences.text_native: Mark a regardé par la fenêtre les bâtiments gris qui défilaient très lentement.

sentences.text_target: He hoped the company would understand the unavoidable reason for his delay.
sentences.phonetic: /hi hoʊpt ðə ˈkʌmpəni wʊd ˌʌndərˈstænd ði ˌʌnəˈvɔɪdəbl ˈrizən fɔr hɪz dɪˈleɪ/
sentences.text_native: Il espérait que l'entreprise comprendrait la raison inévitable de son retard.

sentences.text_target: After forty minutes, the coach finally reached the downtown business district.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈæftər ˈfɔrti ˈmɪnɪts, ðə koʊʧ ˈfaɪnəli riʧt ðə ˈdaʊnˌtaʊn ˈbɪznəs ˈdɪstrɪkt/
sentences.text_native: Après quarante minutes, le car a enfin atteint le quartier d'affaires du centre-ville.

sentences.text_target: Mark stepped down from the vehicle and walked quickly toward his office building.
sentences.phonetic: /mɑrk stɛpt daʊn frəm ðə ˈvihɪkl ənd wɔkt ˈkwɪkli təˈwɔrd hɪz ˈɔfɪs ˈbɪldɪŋ/
sentences.text_native: Mark est descendu du véhicule et a marché d'un pas vif vers son immeuble de bureaux.

sentences.text_target: He entered the lobby, greeting the security guard at the front desk.
sentences.phonetic: /hi ˈɛntərd ðə ˈlɑbi, ˈgritɪŋ ðə sɪˈkjʊrəti gɑrd æt ðə frʌnt dɛsk/
sentences.text_native: Il est entré dans le hall, en saluant l'agent de sécurité à l'accueil.

sentences.text_target: His manager was already sitting at the computer waiting for the presentation.
sentences.phonetic: /hɪz ˈmænəʤər wʌz ɔlˈrɛdi ˈsɪtɪŋ æt ðə kəmˈpjutər ˈweɪtɪŋ fɔr ðə ˌprɛzənˈteɪʃn/
sentences.text_native: Son responsable était déjà assis à son ordinateur à attendre la présentation.

sentences.text_target: Mark sat at his desk, opened his laptop, and apologized for the trouble.
sentences.phonetic: /mɑrk sæt æt hɪz dɛsk, ˈoʊpənd hɪz ˈlæpˌtɑp, ənd əˈpɑləˌʤaɪzd fɔr ðə ˈtrʌbl/
sentences.text_native: Mark s'est assis à son bureau, a ouvert son ordinateur portable et s'est excusé pour ce désagrément.

sentences.text_target: His boss smiled and said that travel disruptions happen to every commuter.
sentences.phonetic: /hɪz bɔs smaɪld ənd sɛd ðæt ˈtrævəl dɪsˈrʌpʃənz ˈhæpən tu ˈɛvəri kəˈmjutər/
sentences.text_native: Son patron a souri en disant que les perturbations de transport arrivent à tous les navetteurs.

sentences.text_target: They began the important meeting without any further complications today.
sentences.phonetic: /ðeɪ bɪˈgæn ði ɪmˈpɔrtnt ˈmitɪŋ wɪˈðaʊt ˈɛni ˈfɜrðər ˌkɑmpləˈkeɪʃnz təˈdeɪ/
sentences.text_native: Ils ont commencé cette réunion importante sans plus de complications aujourd'hui.

sentences.text_target: By evening, Mark hoped his return journey home would be much calmer.
sentences.phonetic: /baɪ ˈivnɪŋ, mɑrk hoʊpt hɪz rɪˈtɜrn ˈʤɜrni hoʊm wʊd bi mʌʧ ˈkɑmər/
sentences.text_native: Le soir venu, Mark espérait que son voyage de retour serait beaucoup plus calme.
